The '''Industrial Monitoring Station''' was a building in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] battled an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] sent by [[Darth Baras]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Darth Vowrawn]] atop the station.<ref name="TOR" />
